code.title: Every modifier side by side
src: -- ignores all filters on DimProduct, including the visual-level filter
Sales ALL Product = CALCULATE ( [Net Sales], ALL ( DimProduct ) )
-- ignores the row's product filter but respects slicers and visual filters
Sales ALLSELECTED Product = CALCULATE ( [Net Sales], ALLSELECTED ( DimProduct ) )
Sales ALLEXCEPT Category = CALCULATE ( [Net Sales], ALLEXCEPT ( DimProduct, DimProduct[Category] ) )
-- removes every filter in the model, including the Region slicer
Sales No Filters = CALCULATE ( [Net Sales], REMOVEFILTERS () )
-- intersects with the current filter instead of replacing it
Water Only Keep = CALCULATE ( [Net Sales], KEEPFILTERS ( DimProduct[Category] = "Water" ) )

i-dax-0.check: Sales No Filters = $33,391.13 on every row regardless of the West slicer. Water Only Keep is blank on non-Water rows. With Category ≠ Apparel, ALL still includes Apparel in its number and ALLSELECTED doesn't.

code.title: Time intelligence set
src: Sales PM = CALCULATE ( [Net Sales], DATEADD ( Dates[Date], -1, MONTH ) )

i-dax-1.check: Net Sales Jan $11,573.97 · Feb $10,327.81 · Mar $11,489.35. MoM %: Jan blank, Feb −10.8%, Mar +11.2%.

code.title: Iterators
src: Avg Sales per Customer = AVERAGEX ( VALUES ( DimCustomer[CustomerKey] ), [Net Sales] )
Best Product Sales = MAXX ( VALUES ( DimProduct[ProductName] ), [Net Sales] )
Customer Rank = RANKX ( ALLSELECTED ( DimCustomer[CustomerName] ), [Net Sales], , DESC, DENSE )
Customers Over 500 = COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( VALUES ( DimCustomer[CustomerKey] ), [Net Sales] > 500 ) )

i-dax-2.check: Avg Sales per Customer = $1,284.27 (both versions agree at the total). Best Product = Drift Paddle Board ($6,659.89). Rank 1 = Lena Moore ($4,464.57). Customers Over 500 = 19.
i-dax-2.note: TOPN can return several rows on a tie. MAXX then returns the alphabetically last name, which is why it is wrapped.

src: DIVIDE ( delta, prev )      -- temporarily: RETURN prev
Sales Summary = "Net " & FORMAT ( [Net Sales], "$#,##0" ) & " across " & [Orders] & " orders"

i-dax-3.check: Card reads "Net $33,391 across 54 orders". In DAX Studio: Home → Server Timings on → Run → read the Total, FE and SE ms on the Server Timings tab.
